_comment: E2E suite layout, read by the `changes` job of e2e_tests.yml.
tier 'fast' runs on every pull request that needs the suite; tier 'full' runs only on pushes to main, the nightly schedule and a dispatch with full=true.

Each entry is one job: `shards` names cli/tests/shards.sh shards, `scripts` names cli/tests scripts, `suite` names steps of the Rust native job. `bundles` lists the golden-app bundles (ts, rust) the job downloads.
The org's free plan shares about 20 concurrent runners across every PR, so the fast tier stays near 15 E2E jobs; fold rather than add.
Job names are check names; renaming one changes the check.
